cases.title: Provider completion with verified staging but unpublished commit

requirement.quote: Provider COMPLETED is merely an observation. If no verified durable result commit exists, Obzio state is PROVIDER_COMPLETED_UNCOMMITTED, never COMPLETED.
requirement.novelty: Combines a valid staged manifest and locally resolvable commit with absence from the declared remote; mere non-empty or local commit checks fail.

cases.title: Published commit whose manifest belongs to a sibling tree

requirement.quote: another process reads every artifact back by immutable SHA
requirement.novelty: The artifact bytes and manifest hash are each valid, but the manifest is not contained by the declared result commit.

cases.title: Mixed current and superseded artifacts at a declared pin

requirement.quote: hashes and byte counts are verified; another process reads every artifact back by immutable SHA
requirement.novelty: Requires the declared pin to verify cleanly while separately refusing a two-artifact result whose mutable ref superseded only one artifact.

cases.title: Identical terminal callback replay after controller restart

requirement.quote: Lost callbacks must replay. Duplicate callbacks must be harmless.
requirement.novelty: Replays an already completed identical callback only after process loss, forcing idempotency to survive memory loss.

cases.title: Non-identical terminal resubmission after controller restart

requirement.quote: Duplicate callbacks must be harmless.
requirement.novelty: Pairs a durable restart with a callback retaining the same unit and idempotency key but changing both commit and artifact set.

cases.title: Terminal regression followed by a second completion

requirement.quote: Every material unit follows CREATED through COMPLETED through ACCEPTED or REJECTED.
requirement.novelty: Attempts a generic state regression before changing the commit, so a guard only on callback ingestion or current state is insufficient.

cases.title: Stale lease with fresh idempotency key after transfer

requirement.quote: An expired/stale worker must not commit after ownership transfers.
requirement.novelty: The stale worker changes its idempotency key after transfer, defeating implementations that confuse callback deduplication with fencing.

cases.title: Guessed higher fence with a plausible current lease identifier

requirement.quote: Before dispatch, durably write lease and fence token.
requirement.novelty: Uses a higher token and correctly formatted guessed lease identifier; comparison-only fencing accepts it.

cases.title: Current lease submitting output for superseded immutable input

requirement.quote: Before dispatch, durably write immutable task input, configuration, source hashes, acceptance hashes.
requirement.novelty: All lease fields are current; only the result's immutable-input identity belongs to the previous attempt.

cases.title: Lost ingestion acknowledgement and triple callback replay

requirement.quote: Lost callbacks must replay. Duplicate callbacks must be harmless.
requirement.novelty: Drops the first acknowledgement and sends two concurrent replays, testing durable idempotency and append serialization together.

cases.title: Idempotency-key collision with non-identical callback bytes

requirement.quote: Duplicate callbacks must be harmless.
requirement.novelty: The second callback reuses the exact key and commit label while changing the manifest payload, requiring byte-level conflict detection.

cases.title: Barrier race between current and stale fenced commits

requirement.quote: Use an append-only ledger, transactional outbox, leases, fencing.
requirement.novelty: Current and stale callbacks cross one execution barrier; sequential tests cannot expose check-then-append races.

cases.title: Tail truncation followed by a newly valid-looking suffix

requirement.quote: Use an append-only ledger.
requirement.novelty: The attacker truncates a sealed tail and appends a different internally valid suffix, so row-chain verification alone remains green.

cases.title: Historical mutation with complete cascade rehash

requirement.quote: Use an append-only ledger.
requirement.novelty: Mutates a non-tail row and recomputes every descendant digest while preserving valid JSON and sequence numbers.

cases.title: Two valid suffixes forked from one sealed predecessor

requirement.quote: Use an append-only ledger, transactional outbox.
requirement.novelty: Presents two individually valid branches sharing sequence and parent hash, requiring equivocation detection rather than local chain validation.

cases.title: Producer self-review through a second display name

requirement.quote: a different producer may then accept or reject it
requirement.novelty: Producer and reviewer strings differ while both resolve to the same authenticated principal and appointment.

cases.title: Independent review attempted before completion then replayed

requirement.quote: only the coordinator sets COMPLETED; a different producer may then accept or reject it
requirement.novelty: A legitimate independent principal reviews too early, then retries the same signed review after completion.

cases.title: Plausible commit attached to an honest terminal failure

requirement.quote: result, logs, tests, limitations and complete artifact manifest are written before Obzio completion
requirement.novelty: The failed result includes a real published diagnostic commit; commit existence must not promote the failed outcome.

cases.title: Validator invoked from a tools-only process boundary

requirement.quote: clean-clone reproduction without provider memory, /tmp, uncommitted files or a warm checkout
requirement.novelty: Imports and invokes the validator with its schema deliberately absent, distinguishing a controlled validation failure from an import-time crash.

cases.title: Recovery after durable result commit but before callback

requirement.quote: 100% recovery of committed results
requirement.novelty: The provider runtime disappears after remote publication and before any callback, requiring remote discovery without rerunning production.

cases.title: Recovery after external effect but before result commit

requirement.quote: automatic resume/rerun of uncommitted tasks from immutable input, zero duplicate external effects
requirement.novelty: Crashes after the idempotent external effect is durable but before result staging, then requires an immutable-input rerun with no second effect.

cases.title: Checkpoint rollback replay after recovery

requirement.quote: Use monotonic checkpoints and a recovery scanner.
requirement.novelty: Replays an old checkpoint from the same valid lease after restart, so lease validation alone cannot preserve monotonicity.

cases.title: Heartbeat and expiry scanner share one logical-time boundary

requirement.quote: Use leases, fencing, monotonic checkpoints and a recovery scanner.
requirement.novelty: A heartbeat and expiry scan race at the original deadline; the durable heartbeat must win and prevent a false lease transfer.

cases.title: Normalized traversal and symlink escape in one write set

requirement.quote: zero out-of-allowlist writes
requirement.novelty: Combines dot-segment traversal with an in-allowlist symlink whose target is outside, requiring canonical target checks before any write.

cases.title: Workflow allowlist basename boundary with dot prefix

requirement.quote: Wave-one writes remain restricted to .github/workflows/po03-*.yml and the PO-03 namespaces.
requirement.novelty: One batch contains a dot-prefixed valid workflow and a lookalike invalid basename, exposing character stripping and substring matching.

cases.title: Clean clone with poisoned matching temporary state

requirement.quote: clean-clone reproduction without provider memory, /tmp, uncommitted files or a warm checkout
requirement.novelty: Runs from a fresh clone while a poisoned /tmp object has the exact expected filename; use of hidden state yields a deterministic wrong marker.

cases.title: Corrupt artifact rejection survives restart into recovery

requirement.quote: corrupt or missing artifact; acceptance requires automatic resume/rerun of uncommitted tasks
requirement.novelty: Requires a durable rejection record, restarts the controller, and then checks that the scanner schedules recovery rather than forgetting or ingesting.

cases.title: Decorative attempt metadata conflicts with durable lease state

requirement.quote: Before dispatch, durably write idempotency key, lease and fence token.
requirement.novelty: The result's checkpoint equals artifact count and its lease fields are plausible defaults, while the durable attempt has different values.

cases.title: Commit resolves in an undeclared remote only

requirement.quote: the result is committed to a deterministic po03/* remote branch
requirement.novelty: The SHA is real and fetchable from a different remote, but absent from the immutable result slot declared before dispatch.

cases.title: Unauthorized completion then valid coordinator completion

requirement.quote: only the coordinator sets COMPLETED
requirement.novelty: A worker first presents a real verified commit, then the coordinator repeats the transition; refusal must not poison the later authorized path.

cases.title: Artifact mutates between verification and commit publication

requirement.quote: hashes and byte counts are verified; result is committed; another process reads every artifact back by immutable SHA
requirement.novelty: Injects a time-of-check/time-of-use mutation after RESULT_VERIFIED but before the commit is constructed.

cases.title: Scanner detects a hidden historical duplicate completion

requirement.quote: Report false-complete counts.
requirement.novelty: The projected current state and latest commit look valid; only scanning complete event history reveals that the unit completed twice.
